venues.blurb: Apply to join the contributor team, or drop an idea in the idea box. Everyone is welcome.

stations.label: Notice board
stations.text: Naija Area is built with help from its players. Apply at reception to join the contributor team (testers, designers, developers, artists, local knowledge, community helpers). Have an idea? Put it in the idea box: we read every one. You need an account (not a guest) so we can find you again. Personal details stay private and you can ask us to delete them.

venues.name: Compound Yard (Suwe)
venues.blurb: Hop Suwe, the old street game, on the chalked boxes. Rules vary by area. Whot and the board are here too.

stations.label: How we play Suwe
stations.text: Suwe (Yoruba hopscotch): throw a stone into box 1, hop through the other boxes on one foot without touching the lines, pick the stone up, then go again from box 2. Finish the boxes and throw the stone over your shoulder to build a house: if it lands on the same number on both sides, that box is yours. Most houses wins. In this game you tap in rhythm. Rules vary by area; this is one common version. (Yoruba text and chants are placeholders for a local reviewer.)
